subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: No test coverage for the new live_preview config. The existing test file already tests other config options (e.g., CONTENTSTACK_FETCH_TIMEOUT at the 'contentstack fetch timeout' describe block) but contains zero assertions for live_preview. A search for 'live_preview|livePreview|live preview|CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW' in the test file returned no matches. Per review criterion #2, new features/config changes require corresponding unit tests. Missing scenarios: (1) live_preview.enable is true and host/management_token are populated when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST is set; (2) live_preview.enable is false when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST is absent.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a describe('live_preview config') block to src/services/__tests__/contentstack.spec.ts with two it() blocks: one setting CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST and CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN and asserting options.live_preview.enable === true, options.live_preview.host === <set value>, options.live_preview.management_token === <set value>; and one with CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST unset asserting options.live_preview.enable === false. Mirror the pattern already used for the CONTENTSTACK_FETCH_TIMEOUT tests.

issues.description: The live_preview object always includes host and management_token as empty strings when live preview is disabled (enable: false). While functionally harmless (the SDK ignores these when enable is false), the prescribed minimal fix used a conditional spread to omit them entirely, which is cleaner and avoids leaking empty-string fields into the config object.
issues.suggestedFix: Consider using the conditional spread pattern from the prescribed fix: live_preview: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST ? { enable: true, host: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST, ...(CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN ? { management_token: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN } : {}) } : { enable: false }. This is optional since the current approach works correctly at runtime.
